newsitem.title: FRANCE: France lifts 96 grain crop estimate to 62.46 mln T.
newsitem.headline: France lifts 96 grain crop estimate to 62.46 mln T.

text.p: The French farm ministry said on Wednesday it raised its estimate for the national 1996 grain crop to 62.46 million tonnes from a previous target of 61.88 million tonnes.
This would compare with a 1995 grain harvest of 53.55 million tonnes.
In its latest estimate as of February 1 the ministry slightly raised its forecast for the 1996 soft wheat crop to 34.69 million tonnes from 34.63 million forecast previously.
This would compare with 29.85 million tonnes of soft wheat produced in 1995.
The ministry also slightly raised its forecast for the 1996 barley crop to 9.46 million tonnes from 9.45 million forecast previously and from 7.69 million tonnes produced in 1995.
It also raised its estimate for the 1996 maize crop to 14.45 million tonnes from a previous estimate of 13.97 million tonnes and 12.74 million tonnes produced in 1995.
